Well-structured monitoring summary with concrete trading metrics, signal strengths, and relevant news, but signals lack actionable direction (buy/sell/hold) and news items have malformed ticker tags [[]]/[["ARB"]] with truncated text.

Well-structured output with specific per-pair strategy scores, margins, and trend deltas, plus a clearly flagged actionable anomaly (SOL assigned strategy has no score while runner-up 'trend' scored 78.95) that warrants investigation; only minor deduction since the mismatch explanation is cut off in the preview.

Clear, well-structured output with actionable orderbook imbalance signals (ETH/SOL/HYPE heavily ask-weighted vs balanced BTC) supported by a detailed metrics table including OI, funding, and book depth; minor deductions for slight redundancy between the alert section and table's Book column.

Well-structured fleet digest with deltas and actionable anomaly flags (news-agent crash, meta stale 134 days), but the leaked instruction prefix ('Now produce the final Discord report:') and contradictory data (whale-mon showing 0% uptime yet high score and activity) reduce trustworthiness.

Well-structured digest with linked arXiv IDs, submission dates, categories, authors, and claimed HTML verification—clearly actionable signal, though the 500-char preview prevents verifying all five entries.
